english.title: Incite participant/organiser of one person protest to breach a condition - Public Order Act
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) incited **(..SPECIFY OTHER PERSON..) who had

(A)_[organised]_
(B)_[carried on]_

a one-person protest, and failed to comply with a condition imposed under section 14ZA of the Public Order Act 1986, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION BREACHED..), when that person knew or ought to have known that the condition had been imposed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14ZA(12) and (14) of the Public Order Act 1986.

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before the coming into force of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
